LanguageData.LP_TowerWreck.description: A Thayan wizard tower fell from the sky, leaving only a broken section of tower and arcane crystals everywhere. Wild magic spills out within 15 cells of the wreck: people and animals staying nearby now and then turn invisible, speed up, get teleported, sprout flowers, hiccup or change color (none are lethal).\n\nDeconstructing it yields scrolls, steel, plasteel and possibly curiosities.
